sources.title: La recaudación de impuestos creció 10,6% el año 2025
sources.note: Total SIN collection Bs 45,910 million in 2025 (Bs 41,524.8 million in 2024): IVA 13,655 (29.7%), IUE 10,722 (23.3%), IT 7,338 (15.9%), other taxes 14,195 (31.1%). The total includes domestic-market taxes plus IDH, IEHD and ITF (see the SIN memoria).

sources.title: Memoria Enero–Octubre 2025
sources.note: Chapter 1 'La gestión de recaudaciones': Bs 38,400.3 million collected to October 2025, of which domestic market 89.2%, IEHD + ITF 3.7% (Bs 1,436.2 million) and IDH 7.1% (Bs 2,717.4 million). Publication date approximate (November 2025).

sources.title: Cuadro General de Impuestos en Vigencia (national taxes, taxable events, rates)
sources.note: Confirms IVA 13%, IT 3%, IUE 25%, IGF 1.4%/1.9%/2.4% above Bs 30 million as of the October 2025 edition. Publication date approximate (October 2025).

sources.title: Proyecto de Ley transparenta el IVA y fija tasa efectiva real del 13%
sources.note: Bill sent to the Legislative Assembly to show IVA separately on invoices (today the 13% is included in the price, an effective rate of about 14.94%). Passage not confirmed at the check date.
